maria: Hi sec team — I need temporary admin access to prod-console to run a schema migration on the orders service. ~30 minutes during the low-traffic window (target start 15:00 UTC). Jira: PROJ-4321. I will monitor and revert feature flags if anything looks off. Ping for approvals.

 tom: Can you paste the short runbook and confirm why we can’t run this in staging?

 maria: Runbook (short):
```
1) Put feature_flag.orders_schema=off
2) Run migration: ./migrations/run_orders_schema.sh --safe-check
3) Verify replicas report OK in /health and run small smoke tests
4) Toggle feature_flag.orders_schema=on if all green
```
Staging has different replica topology and we need to hit the production sharded indexes to ensure the migration applies correctly. This is low-risk and read-only for first step.

 aj: Need two things before I can approve: link the ticket with business-justification and confirm session recording + MFA enforced for the session. Also: no data exports. Once those are present I can grant limited admin for 35m.

 access-bot: Request received for user maria. Please ensure the ticket includes `business-justification` and `rollback-plan`. Audit requirement: audit=on. (system)

 liz: I can babysit the migration. If approved I'll execute the grant command for the role and watch logs. Command I'll use: 
```
./tools/grant --user=maria --role=prod-admin --scope=console --ttl=35m --audit=on
```

 maria: Ticket updated with justification and rollback steps: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROJ-4321. MFA is enabled for my account and session recording is on.

 tom: +1 from me for operational reasons (need to ship the migration). Note: no DB dumps, no offsite copies.

 aj: Approving now with the stated conditions (no exports, session recording on). Logging the approval. :lock:

 access-bot: Admin role scheduled for maria. Token id: tok_abc123. Expires at 2109877143 (35m). Audit entry created: /audit/2109876543/maria.

 maria: Thanks everyone — starting the migration now, will post results. :thumbsup:

 maria: Migration complete. Feature flag toggled back, smoke tests passed (all checks green). I revoked the token early. Audit link: https://console.redwood.local/audit/2109876543.

 tom: Thanks for the quick run and detailed notes.

 aj: Closing the approval thread. Follow up if any anomalies show up.
